summary: Implement secure checkout, order subtotal calculation, and payment processing
description: Customers must be able to securely complete checkout and payment without duplicate charges, gateway timeout failures, or math mismatches.
acceptance_criteria: **Calculation Precision:** Cart subtotal, taxes, and final total calculations must match down to two decimal places without rounding errors.
**Gateway Timeouts:** Payment gateway timeouts (after 30 seconds) must trigger a graceful fallback message without double-charging the user.
**Button Debounce:** Rapid clicking on the 'Place Order' button must be blocked by frontend debounce to prevent duplicate order generation.
**Data Privacy & Masking:** Sensitive credit card data must be masked in transit and never logged in plain text in system logs or error reports.
**Secure Payment:** Payment details must go through a secure payment gateway. Sending raw card details over an unsecured connection must fail immediately.
**Safe Typing:** Address and zip code boxes must clean up any weird text or code attempts to keep the system safe from malicious inputs.
**Order Wrap-Up:** After placing an order, the confirmation page and email should show the right info safely and give a working link to set up a password.
